findings.title: After a 409 on a status change the row keeps showing the stale status and every retry fails the same way
findings.evidence: cr2.mjs output: UI row 'Microbe Detective | Microbiology | Draft | Mark reviewed' while server status is approved; clicking 3x gives each time role=alert 'Could not update the status: Content cannot move from approved to reviewed; the next step is draft.' and the row stays 'Draft / Mark reviewed' (no refetch). Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/cr2-409-d.png
findings.repro: node /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/cr2.mjs d (opens Content review, moves mic-01 to approved via API behind the UI, clicks Mark reviewed repeatedly)
findings.expected: After a 409/404 the list is reloaded (or the row refreshed) so the page shows the server status and the legal next action; the alert is then actionable.
findings.actual: The governance page keeps displaying a wrong approval status (Draft for an approved mission) and offers an action that can never succeed; only leaving the page and coming back recovers (second teacher tab or stale tab is enough to trigger it).
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx setStatus() catch block (~line 150): on ApiError 409/404 call reload() (useLoad) or re-fetch /content/missions and setData, keep the alert.

findings.area: Guest recovery notice vs guest switch
findings.title: The 'Your faculty guest session expired...' notice survives a guest switch and is shown to the student (and the reverse)
findings.evidence: sw1.mjs: after recovery as faculty, clicking 'Student guest' gives h1 'Continue your investigations.' with role=status 'Your faculty guest session expired, so a new faculty guest session was opened.'; it is still there after switching to Faculty and back ('return to student' line of the output). Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/sw1-student-notice-m.png
findings.expected: A role switch (Faculty guest / Student guest / Return to student demo / Reset) clears the recovery notice; the notice only describes the session that expired.
findings.actual: notice state lives in App and is never cleared by enterGuest, so the student dashboard states that a FACULTY session was reopened (wrong role wording). The reverse (student notice on faculty pages) follows from the same code.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/app.tsx enterGuest(): setNotice('') when called from switchGuest/resetGuest (keep it only for the onUnauthorized path), or clear it in the success branch when the role differs from lastRole.current.

findings.title: Empty class shows 'Completion 0%' (and 'Needs attention 0 / Follow-up recommended') instead of 'no data'
findings.evidence: err/axe1 shot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/axe1-empty-t.png: Students 0, Completion 0% 'Across assigned missions', Needs attention 0 'Follow-up recommended'. API: avgCompletionPct 0 for a class with 0 students (be/src/game.ts roster.length ? ... : 0).
findings.expected: Zero students gives '—' (like missions without data) and neutral captions; 0% asserts that nobody completed anything.
findings.actual: A measured-looking 0% is displayed for an undefined average; caption 'Follow-up recommended' stays under 0.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx ~line 113: when analytics.cohort.students === 0 render '—' for Completion; make the Needs attention detail conditional. Optionally return null from be/src/game.ts analytics() for avgCompletionPct when no students.

findings.title: Two students with the same name are indistinguishable (identical roster buttons and identical picker options, no id or other discriminator)
findings.evidence: dup1.mjs output: 2 buttons 'Open Alex Martin' ('Alex Martin | 77% | On track' and 'Alex Martin | 50% | Accuracy under 60%'); Student picker options ['Alex Martin','Alex Martin']. Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/dup1-m.png (the real shared guest 'Alex Martin' is in the seeded class, so any student who joins with that name collides)
findings.expected: A minimal disambiguator (join order, short suffix like #47 or initials of last activity) without exposing email.
findings.actual: The teacher can open or act on the wrong learner; accessible names are identical too.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx roster list and StudentView <option>: append a non-PII discriminator when names collide.

findings.title: Roster rows show a bare percentage with no label, and aria-label='Open <name>' hides the percentage and the attention reason from assistive technology
findings.evidence: ariaSnapshot: button "Open Marie Dubois": Marie Dubois 55% Accuracy under 60% (name is only 'Open Marie Dubois'); visible text '55%' has no 'accuracy' wording next to it (column header absent) - see /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/t1-analytics-d.png
findings.expected: Visible and accessible text says what the number is (Accuracy 55%) and the reason ('Accuracy under 60%') is part of the name/description.
findings.actual: Screen-reader users tabbing the roster hear only 'Open <name>, button'; sighted users cannot tell accuracy from completion.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx ~line 121: drop aria-label (visible text already starts with the name) or use aria-describedby; add 'accuracy' to the visible text/header.

findings.title: Content review shows no reviewer name or time although the API returns reviewedBy and updatedAt; saving has no status text
findings.evidence: PUT /content/missions/hem-01/status returns reviewedBy 'Dr. Claire Moreau', updatedAt 1791453365153 (cr1.mjs); page columns are only MISSION/LAB/STATUS/ACTION (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-C/shots/axe1-content409-d.png). During a save only the buttons are disabled (no role=status).
findings.expected: Who last moved the mission and when is visible next to the status (the governance page's purpose), and a save announces itself.
findings.actual: Normalizer drops reviewedBy/updatedAt; approvals are anonymous in the UI.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/content.ts + web/src/pages/faculty.tsx content-row: read reviewedBy/updatedAt (nullable) and render 'Reviewed by X, date'.

findings.title: Mission success % is shown without its sample size; the Master mission with one completion is ranked among standard missions despite the 'never counted' note
findings.evidence: mst.mjs: list order 'Gram Stain Challenge 65%', 'Clinical Detective 67%', 'Anemia Detective 69%'... after ONE student cleared the Master Lab (studentsCompleted 1; payload field studentsCompleted is validated but unused). Footnote says 'the Master Lab mission is listed but never counted in class analytics'.
findings.expected: Show 'n of N students' next to each % (a 1-student 67% is not comparable to 41-student 91%) and sort/mark Master separately.
findings.actual: 65%, 67%, 69% look equally reliable; only the single weakest mission is flagged even though three are under the 70% threshold (UI copy discloses the single flag).
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx mission-signal li: render m.studentsCompleted; exclude labSlug==='master' from the ranked order or put it last.

notes: Verified R8: faculty role recovery after reload holds for all 3 faculty pages (once / token removed / persistent 401: faculty notice + faculty nav, guard halts with alert and Retry after 3 loops, role key stays teacher); 401 on a content PUT recovers as faculty too; failed guest switch keeps role and shows role=alert. Could NOT break: error matrix on every faculty GET (403/404/409/429/500/503/bad JSON/empty/{}/null/[]/abort x 7 endpoints) always gives a visible role=alert with right heading and Retry, never a default; content PUT with 403/404/409/429/500/invalid/incomplete payload gives role=alert and unchanged row; double-click on a transition only advances once; reordered responses (class switch x3 with 2.5s delay, student switch, class switch on Student detail) never show stale class data; axe (wcag2a/aa/21/22 + best-practice) is clean on analytics, show-all, empty class, student detail, content, 409 alert and error state at 375/768/1440; no horizontal overflow at 320x640, 320x200, 375x300 even with an 80-char unbroken name, emoji ZWJ, RTL, combining marks, 80-char class name; console clean apart from the browser resource logs of injected statuses; no email/ids shown to teachers (only numeric ids in JSON). Numeric integrity: played bio-01/02/03 (wrongs/hints), unlocked biochemistry/microbiology/master via API as the guest and recomputed independently: cohort completion 63.457 exact vs 63 shown (mean of rounded 63.467), mission success, studentsCompleted sums (257=257), roster vs analytics.roster vs student detail (0 mismatches for 38 students), avg accuracy, needsAttention count, lab results XP/ledger sums (345, 435, 490), accuracy means, hints (4/5 best attempts), leaderboard rank/XP vs profile/dashboard/detail: all equal; only differences are the documented Master exclusion (dashboard 10 of 10 vs faculty 9). Visual inspection done at 375/768/1440 for all faculty pages. The full-page screenshot background cut at 100vh is background-attachment:fixed, not a defect. Roster search/sort/filter do not exist in the UI (backend supports q/status); not reported as a defect.
